skill_name: Compose a letter to your best friend who has just moved abroad.
workflow:
Dear Best Friend,

I wanted to reach out and wish you all the best on your new journey! I can’t believe you have moved all the way across the world and are exploring a new place and culture. I know you’re going to make amazing memories and I can’t wait to hear all about it when you get back.

I hope this letter finds you well in your new home and that you’re feeling happy and fulfilled. I miss having you over for game nights and movie marathons, but I’m sure all the new experiences you’re having
